page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title lines top to bottom; central woodcut engraving with stamps and printer's device at the foot; no margin text.
page.notes: Woodcut engraving of a horse with a banner and figures in an oval frame, with an ornamental oval device at left. Library stamps ("Biblioteca Nazionale Vittorio Emanuele, Roma" and a round stamp) and a printer's device at the lower right are not transcribed. Several words in the title are in mixed large and italic type; the second title line is partly overprinted by stamp-like marks and read as printed.
